people.text: Philip's family would like to see fish as well as land animals, and listen to talks about the animals. They want to travel there by train.
Asha wants a wildlife park that gives discounts for visiting with lots of friends, and where visitors can have rides on some of the animals. She'd like to feed some animals, too.

Chanming's family want a wildlife park with activities for Chanming's five - year - old brother. Chanming wants to know what it's like to work at the park, and be able to ask staff questions after his visit, too.
Gabriella and her family want to see animals from all over the world, and be able to touch some of them. They'd like to have a guided tour while they're there.
Kuba and his family want to stay overnight at the wildlife park. They'd like to be able to see some large animals and take home information on all of the animals there.

items.label: A
items.title: Hallmouth Wildlife Park
items.text: Hallmouth's famous for its large open areas full of monkeys, giraffes and kangaroos! There's also a special play area for younger visitors. Listen to guides and other experts explaining what they do at the park - stay in touch with them by joining their weekly online chat on the park's website!

items.label: B
items.title: Greenway Wildlife Park
items.text: At Greenway, you can go around some parts of the park on a horse or a camel. Visitors can also learn what monkeys eat, and even give them their lunch. The animals here are all from Africa and Europe. Cheaper tickets are available for groups of ten or more, and the park is just ten minutes from the train station.

items.label: C
items.title: Rainforest Fun
items.text: The main attraction is a huge glass building containing plants from a rainforest, where animals and birds move around freely. Although there isn't really enough to entertain young children or adults for a whole day, it's still an interesting experience. Don't miss the sharks in the building next door, and the larger animals in the rest of the park!

items.label: D
items.title: Jumblehouse Wildlife Park
items.text: At Jumblehouse, you'll see many species from around the world, including elephants and giraffes. The shop sells some great books, with details about everything you'll see at the wildlife park. There's so much to do here, you might need two days, so why not book a room at our hotel?

items.label: E
items.title: Naturatastic
items.text: Driving up to Naturatastic, you'll see the beautiful 18th - century house and, beside it, the elephants and zebras. There are plenty of staff to show you around and tell you about their work. If you're lucky, you may also see some of the large fish in the lake.

items.label: F
items.title: Kingston Wildlife Park
items.text: Just a short walk from the railway station, Kingston's a great place to watch wildlife from around the world, including sharks and many other sea creatures. Every hour, join other visitors in the Kingston Building to hear experts giving information about the amazing wildlife in the park. They can also answer any questions you may have.

items.label: G
items.title: Cliftop Wildlife Park
items.text: With creatures from every continent, Cliftop is the biggest wildlife park in the area. It's great for younger visitors - staff will allow them to hold many of the small friendly animals. They take groups around the rest of the park too, and tell them about all the animals. The nearby hotel is great value.

items.label: H
items.title: Bridwell Cross Wildlife Park
items.text: The perfect place for learning about animals - there are daily talks about many of the species here. The small farm, where you can feed the sheep and goats, also has rabbits that visitors can pick up. There's a wide range of books about animals available in the shop.

explanations.6: Philip 家人想既看鱼类又看陆地动物，听动物讲座，乘火车前往。F 选项 Kingston Wildlife Park 离火车站近，可看鲨鱼等海洋生物和世界各地野生动物，每小时有专家讲座，符合需求。原文 “short walk from railway station, see sharks and sea creatures, experts giving information” 对应 “fish and land animals, talks, train travel”。
explanations.7: Asha 想要给多人参观打折的野生动物园，可骑乘动物、喂食。B 选项 Greenway Wildlife Park 对 10 人以上团体有更便宜门票，可骑马或骆驼，给猴子喂食，符合需求。原文 “cheaper tickets for groups of ten or more, go around on a horse or camel, give monkeys their lunch” 对应 “discount for groups, rides, feed animals”。
explanations.8: Chanming 家人想要有适合 5 岁弟弟活动的野生动物园，Chanming 想了解在公园工作的感觉并在参观后能向工作人员提问。A 选项 Hallmouth Wildlife Park 有儿童特别游乐区，可听 guides 讲解工作，通过加入每周在线聊天与他们保持联系，符合需求。原文 “special play area for younger visitors, listen to guides explain what they do, join online chat” 对应 “activities for little brother, know about working at park, ask questions after visit”。
explanations.9: Gabriella 家人想看到来自世界各地的动物，能触摸一些，有导游带领参观。G 选项 Cliftop Wildlife Park 有来自各大洲的生物，工作人员允许年轻游客触摸许多小型友好动物，带团体参观并讲解，符合需求。原文 “creatures from every continent, allow them to hold small friendly animals, take groups around” 对应 “animals from all over the world, touch, guided tour”。
explanations.10: Kuba 家人想在野生动物园过夜，看到一些大型动物并带回家所有动物的信息。D 选项 Jumblehouse Wildlife Park 有酒店可预订房间，能看到大象和长颈鹿等大型动物，商店出售详述在公园所见一切的好书，符合需求。原文 “book a room at our hotel, see elephants and giraffes, shop sells books with details, 对应 “stay overnight, large animals, take home information”。
